name: GDollar
oneLiner: GDLR is Doma's Ethereum gold token, representing 10 mg of fine gold as a contractual redemption claim against Lumina Secure S.A. in Panama.
collateral: Allocated physical gold bars (minimum 995.0 fineness) held in segregated vault sub-accounts through an undisclosed custodian and owned by KSTN Capital Ltd, an affiliate of issuer Lumina Secure S.A. (Panama). Each GDLR represents 10 mg of fine gold and is backed on-chain by ERC-3643 GReserve (GLDR) tokens locked in the GDLR VaultContract.
pegMechanism: Each GDLR represents a contractual redemption right against Lumina Secure S.A. for 10 mg of fine gold, not proprietary or trust ownership of the bullion. Onboarded, KYC-verified holders outside excluded jurisdictions may redeem whole physical bars (minimum 1 troy oz / 3,110.35 GDLR) for collection at a designated vault or redeem digitally for USDC or USDT, targeting 10 Panama business days. Schedule A charges a $200 application fee plus 10% for physical redemption or 10.7% for digital redemption. On-chain transfers also carry an admin-configurable transfer tax (currently 0.10%, capped at 1.00%).

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: GDLR is a direct gold-referenced commodity claim: Doma General Terms and Conditions v3.0 (effective 2026-11-13) and Reserve Policy v2.0 (updated 2026-10-26) define each GDLR token as a contractual redemption right against Lumina Secure S.A. (Panama) for 10 mg of fine physical gold (0.0003215075 troy oz), backed 1:1 on a fine-mass basis by allocated physical gold owned by group entity KSTN Capital Ltd and evidenced on-chain by locked ERC-3643 GReserve tokens.

notices.title: On-chain transfer tax and high redemption fees
notices.message: Non-exempt GDLR transfers currently incur a 0.10% on-chain transfer tax (configurable up to 1.00% by the admin EOA). Primary redemption through Lumina Secure S.A. requires KYC onboarding outside excluded jurisdictions, a 1 troy oz minimum, a $200 application fee, and 10% physical or 10.7% digital processing fees.
